answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, revoked by a single upheld challenge, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The opal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The ocean holds work receipts rather than names, so the inlet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
